title: SQL Server: scoping to one schema doesn't reduce schema exploration

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, three schemas of 100 tables, one run

symptom: Schema Exploration says "Found 300 table(s) in the connection" with the pipeline scoped to one 100-table schema. The same catalog statements ran per pass at 300 tables and at 100.
cause: Discovery reads the whole connection; the scope applies to the ingestion reads.
effect: The discovery count doesn't show the scope.
fix: Expect discovery to count the whole connection; the scope cuts the ingestion reads.
notes: The optimized metadata path wasn't tested.
